newsitem.title: UK: British fund managers turn bearish on equities.
newsitem.headline: British fund managers turn bearish on equities.

text.p: Britain's fund managers are becoming increasingly pessimistic on the outlook for world equity markets, according to Merrill Lynch's monthly survey of investment intentions.
"UK-based fund managers are less optimistic about the three month outlook for all global equity markets," Merrill Lynch strategist Bijal Shah said.
The survey, which covered 80 institutions managing over one 1.0 trillion pounds in assets, showed fund managers were most bearish on the U.S. stockmarket.
